questions.question:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

No card is a parcel.

All cards are envelopes.

Some envelopes are bags.

Conclusions:

I. All envelopes can never be parcels.

II. No card is a bag.

III. At least some bags are postcards.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/22727ac421d139bfc61e8e42944dffad6c82328e1e649a323e7454435c2cacfd.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All envelopes can never be parcels → Follow (As no card is a parcel and all cards are envelopes. As whole card comes in envelopes and cannot be parcel, therefore it is true.)

II. No card is a bag → Does not follow (As no card is a parcel, all cards are envelopes and some envelopes are bags. As no direct relation is given between card and bags, therefore it is possible but not definite.)

III. At least some bags are postcards → Does not follow (As no relation with postcards is given, therefore it is false).

∴ Here, Only conclusion I follows.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.

⇒ __**41**____** –**____** 8**__ = ?

⇒ **33 = ?**

questions.question:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

Some tears are drops.

Some drops are streams.

All streams are rivers.

Conclusions:

I. All tears can never be rivers.

II. Some drops are rivers.

III. All tears being streams is a possibility.

options.text: Both I and II conclusion follow
Both II and III conclusion follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8cf4efe24b88d80e527249a16174580c7b864f57bf583771f0079e229247e2f9.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All tears can never be rivers → Does not follow (As some tears are drops, some drops are streams and all streams are rivers. As no direct relation is given between tears and rivers, therefore it is false.)

II. Some drops are rivers → **F**ollow (As some drops are streams and all streams are rivers. As whole streams comes in rivers and has some part common with drops, therefore it is true.)

III. All tears being streams is a possibility → Follow (As some tears are drops, some drops are streams. As no statements restricts tears from being streams, therefore it is possible.)

∴ Here, Both II and III conclusion follow.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
In the following number-pairs, the second number is obtained by applying certain mathematical operations to the first number. In three of the four pairs, the same pattern is applied and hence they form a group. Select the number-pair that DOES NOT belong to this group.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Option 1) 335 - 119

__**335 - 119**__ = 216

216 = 216 (LHS = RHS)

Option 2) 358 - 152

__**358 - 152**__ = 206

**206 ≠ 216 (LHS ≠ RHS)**

Option 3) 317 - 101

__**317 - 101**__ = 216

216 = 216 (LHS = RHS)

Option 4) 308 - 92

__**308 - 92**__ = 216

216 = 216 (LHS = RHS)

Thus, out of all the options, '358 - 152' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.

19 is related to 209 → 19 × 11 = 209

Similarly, 61 is related: → 61 × 11 = **671**

Hence, the correct answer is **"671".**

questions.question:
The question contains pairs of words that are related to each other in a certain way. Three of the following four word pairs are alike as these have the same relationship and thus form a group. Which word pair is the one that DOES NOT belong to that group?

(The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be related to each other based on the number of letters/number of consonants/vowels in the word.)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is: **Each of the other word pairs correctly matches a polygon with the number of its sides.**

 
• Triangle has 3 sides
 
• Pentagon has 5 sides
 
• Square has 4 sides

Whenever, a Hexagon has **6 sides**, not 8.

Therefore, "**Hexagon - 8 sides**" is the word pair that does not belong to the group.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Hexagon - 8 sides".**

questions.question:
In a certain code language,

'A + B' means 'A is the mother of B',

'A - B' means 'A is the father of B',

'A $ B' means 'A is the son of B',

'A % B' means 'A is the sister of B',

'A / B' means 'A is the wife of B' and

'A = B' means 'A is the brother of B'.

Which of the following means A is the daughter of K?

i. A + K / J - P = D

ii. J % P = K + A = D

iii. K + A / P - D % J

iv. D + K = A / P – J
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Decoding symbols:

 
 

 
 A is

 -
 $

 Meaning
 Mother
 Father
 Son
 Sister
 Wife
 Brother
 
 

 
 to B
 
 

**So,**

i. A + K / J - P = D → A is mother of K who is the wife of J who is the father of P who is the brother of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1883b1c474e8170c4c084fb28a004b1cec97067b90f91d43080ef595d7e67d2d.png] 

Here, A is the mother of K.

ii. J % P = K + A = D → J is sister of P who is the brother of K who is the mother of A who is the brother of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08ab9ce4479ef8e44b60157c8526521429ff04bbae1965517e4b9fd633e68b5b.png] 

Here, A is the son of k.

iii. K + A / P - D % J → K is mother of A who is the wife of P who is the father of D who is the sister of J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2f303774db105453eee90d50dd948c8d78d841d249ff436907071b89f2850433.png] 

**Here, A is the daughter of K.**

iv. D + K = A / P – J → D is mother of K who is the brother of A who is the wife of P who is the father of J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9727fe1a998ad285300026ce0f7f19fc3ca3fb628d7862d76e501e54c79a581f.png] 

Here, A is the sister of K.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3"
